rows.name: National Risk Register 2026
rows.semantic_limit: The register provides national likelihood and impact assessments for resilience planning; it must not be converted into a deterministic local, household or exact-parcel hazard score.
rows.evidence_basis: The official 2026 National Risk Register is the public-facing version of the UK government's assessment of the most serious risks facing the UK.

rows.name: Ambulance Quality Indicators Systems Indicators for June 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Ambulance-service incident and response-time measures are service-area and monthly operational statistics; they do not establish emergency response performance at a specific address or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: Accredited official statistics cover call answering, incidents, response categories, resource allocation and handover times for England's ambulance services.

rows.name: A&E attendances and emergency admissions June 2026 and Q1
rows.semantic_limit: Provider-level attendances, admissions and waiting-time aggregates describe health-system activity and cannot be attributed to an exact household, building or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: Accredited official statistics report A&E attendances, emergency admissions and waiting-time measures for providers in England.

rows.name: Building Safety Regulator approval application data April to June 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Application volumes, determination times and outcomes concern regulatory workflow for higher-risk buildings; they do not prove the compliance or safety condition of a named building or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: Official transparency data cover building-control approval applications, decision outcomes and statutory-time-limit performance for higher-risk buildings in England.

rows.name: Food hygiene ratings downloadable open data
rows.semantic_limit: Ratings reflect conditions found at the recorded inspection or visit date; they are business-establishment observations and must not be generalized to neighbouring parcels or current conditions without freshness checks.
rows.evidence_basis: The official FSA service publishes daily-updated downloadable food hygiene rating data by local authority and for all participating authorities.

rows.name: Food Hygiene Rating Scheme API version 2
rows.semantic_limit: API coordinates and ratings describe registered food businesses and inspection results; location data do not establish wider environmental or parcel safety.
rows.evidence_basis: The official FHRS API provides free programmatic access to rating data without registration, API keys or login.

rows.name: UK Government Emergency Alerts current status
rows.semantic_limit: The current-alert state is a time-sensitive national service snapshot; absence of an alert is not proof that a locality or parcel has no hazard.
rows.evidence_basis: The official Emergency Alerts status page stated there were no current alerts at the verification time and explains the life-threatening-emergency service.

rows.name: Prepare alerts and warnings guidance
rows.semantic_limit: The guidance identifies warning channels and response advice; it is not a live hazard observation and cannot release a local or exact-parcel score.
rows.evidence_basis: The official Prepare guidance describes Emergency Alerts and other warning services for flooding, fires, extreme weather and local risks.
